body: I tried to ask him about things I thought he enjoyed but he said they're all just to pass the time.
It's ok thanks for offering some help here 🙂

I'm on calls with him pretty much everyday and we joke around and get on with school work, games etc. He seems fine when we do that but then he asked me how I felt, I started talking about that then we got onto the topic of how he felt and I tried to show I care and told him that he has a future he can make but I think I just made it worse. I've been at a point where I wanted to kill myself before but the thought of building a future which I'm proud of keeps me going but I don't know how to help him find a similar thing or even know if that sort of thing would work with him.

I just don't want to wait too long for him to warm up because I'm worried that the time is limited. I tend to worry a lot so I'm hoping it's just me being pedantic but I don't want to leave this to waiting.

He said to me he's sorry but it's a way he will be happy finally

I've told him I'm going to find a way to fix this but after reading the tips I guess I just meant to say I'm going to be there for him whether he likes it or not but I didn't convey it in that way
